scope: The 48 existing native tile crops and bounded original gaps remain unchanged. The separately registered 360-cell portrait pool contains 96 CC-BY-4.0 source adaptations and 264 Apache-2.0 original cells. No full source sheets, labeled contact sheets, fonts, unselected packs, walking frames or expression matrix are shipped.

portraits.creator: Dezra's Dragons
portraits.modifications: Female/male adult and elder source torso/head components cropped and assembled; exact opaque gray ground removed; modern clothes painted; skin/hair and iris palettes recolored; elder facial contours, creases and modern spectacles added. Baby/child/neutral/unknown-age cells are original manual pixel commands, never resized adult source heads. Original square rails cover every torso's bottom edge. Exact templates and per-cell hashes are retained in the modification record.
portraits.scope: Author-approved local rollout. Recorded sex and age choose female/male/neutral and baby0-2/child3-17/adult18-59/elder60+/unknown pools. Skin/hair palette and variant remain person-ID bound across pools. No RNG, generated imagery, appearance fact or publication approval is asserted.

packing.algorithm: Stable-order shelf packing per lineage; left to right, wrap before width overflow, row height=max selected crop height, transparent RGBA canvas.
packing.png: Pillow PNG, RGBA8, optimize=False, compress_level=9; no labels or resampling.

person_selection: Cosmetic identity/authoritative whole-year age only; baby <3, child <13, adult <65, elder >=65. Unknown age uses only unknown_age. No sex, skin, kinship or rule RNG facts are inferred.

runtime_art.creation: Original integer-pixel notebook spreads, memorial portrait frame, Underworld archive shelves/desk/lamp, mourning cloth, inheritance ledger, debt desk, divided quarrel backdrop, childhood toy blocks, school-age chalkboard, adult-life satchel, newborn cradle and Dream message setting. Rectangular fills are authored directly in the renderer; no external imagery, font, new pack or generated image is added.
runtime_art.materials: All scene people use SpriteSet.portraits and portraitId with captured actual person/sex/age at native 64px scale1. Canonical stage-geometry.ts defines416x192 source pixels; the discrete CSS scale1/2 applies equally to portraits and scenery, giving832x384 within the observed848px content column. Below416px, only the accessible stage viewport scrolls. Existing Kenney house/candle and original cloud/seal props retain native pixels and their original lineage; no independent source or portrait enlargement.
